players.product: quartz electronic yarn and ultra-thin quartz electronic cloth for high-frequency / high-speed CCL (vertically integrated from quartz sand to cloth; in customer testing and end-customer certification)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (05-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Quartz electronic cloth (2025 annual results briefing): director and board secretary Zheng Wei said the project is still in small-batch client testing and end-customer certification, and that wholly owned subsidiary Hubei Dingyi New Materials is building a new 1,000-tonne quartz electronic yarn line; the company has won a group of global CCL makers as customers and has stable cooperation with well-known international downstream companies, but orders remain uncertain because of customer product iteration and fit testing. Chairman Shang Chunli and CFO Wei Xuebing said quartz electronic cloth sales were RMB 1,312.48 ten-thousand in H1 2025 (RMB 9,837.37 ten-thousand for the year). The company did not confirm market rumours about end customers.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2025 quartz electronic cloth sales RMB 1,312.48 ten-thousand; new 1,000-tonne quartz electronic yarn line

quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (05-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Other businesses (2025 annual results briefing): CFO Wei Xuebing said the Q1 2026 gross-margin decline was mainly due to a change in sales mix, and that subsidiary Shanghai Shichuang's 2025 revenue fell mainly on lower photovoltaic demand and tougher competition while its loss came mainly from much higher R&D spending at Hefei Guangwei, Jinan Guangwei and other projects. Board secretary Zheng Wei said the company can make TFT-LCD photomask substrates in all sizes from G4.5 to G10.5 and Hefei Guangwei's photomask-substrate precision-processing project has been completed and put into production; in high-end quartz, large-scale melting of titanium-doped ultra-low-expansion synthetic quartz achieved a key breakthrough, the sandwich composite product achieved a size breakthrough with customer acceptance, and the VAD product went into production and customer use, with high-end optical material sales up sharply. It is the dominant domestic supplier of quartz glass fiber for aerospace, serving mainly the domestic aerospace market.
quarterly_data.figure: TFT-LCD photomask substrates G4.5 to G10.5
